purpose: Add eight devotional poem excerpts on compassion, guidance, atonement, gratitude, service, hope, and intercession.

defaults.author: Charles H. Gabriel
defaults.sourceTitle: The Slighted Stranger and Other Poems
defaults.rightsBasis: Published in the 1915 Rodeheaver Company edition, public domain in the United States. Excerpts are checked against stored OCR; page-scan verification remains required before publication.

entries.title: I Want to Be True
entries.text:
When I think how compassionate, tender, and kind
He was to the poor, to the sick and the blind;
When nothing but love in His pathway I find,
I want to be true to Him.
entries.slideText:

entries.sourceLocator: I Want to Be True, printed page 58
entries.recommendedUse: Use as a poetic response to Christ's compassion, with the Gospel accounts supplying the historical teaching.

entries.title: The Story Never Old
entries.text:
He took upon Himself the guilt
Of all my sins and thine.
And on the cross of Calvary
He paid thy debt and mine.

entries.title: Showers of Mercy
entries.text:
Jesus, my King, how shall I sing
Praise that shall be worthy of Thee?
Why shouldst Thou, Lord,
Me thus reward
With numberless, measureless blessings?
entries.slideText:

entries.title: Wounded for Me
entries.text:
THOU infinite Savior, on Thee I depend;
Thou art my salvation, Redeemer and Friend.

entries.title: Do Your Best
entries.text:
Make your daily life a happy song of praise;
You can brighten up the world in many ways.
Do not mar the future beauties with delays —
But trust in God and do your best.
entries.slideText:

entries.recommendedUse: Use to encourage faithful daily service; effort is a response to grace, not a means of earning salvation.

entries.title: Sometime I'll Understand
entries.text:
I'll bear the cross He gives for His dear sake.
Where love my ev'ry step has planned.
For when, thro' grace, in Heaven I awake
Sometime I'll understand.
entries.slideText:

entries.recommendedUse: Use sensitively as a poet's expression of future hope, without promising an explanation for every loss.

entries.title: Come into My Life
entries.text:
That I may have purity day after day.
In closer communion with Thee by the way.
And more of Thy Spirit for others to pray.
Come into my life, be the King of my heart.
